title: Imaging the molecular outflows of the prototypical ULIRG NGC 6240 with ALMA
question: What are the spatial and velocity distributions of the molecular outflows in the merging ULIRG NGC 6240, as traced by broad CO (2-1) wings?

evidence.quote: which is 86 $\pm$ 15 % of the single-dish value (cite: Papadopoulos14)

what.value: Systemic velocities of nuclei 7122 (north) and 7164 (south) km/s

evidence.quote: the systemic velocity of the northern (southern) nucleus of 7122 (7164) km s$^{-1}$ in the radio LSRK velocity frame (cite: Hagiwara10)
Using the nuclear SFR of $\sim$61 $M_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$ derived from radio-to-FIR SED fitting (cite: Yun02)

recipe.method: Self-calibrate, subtract continuum in uv, multiscale clean with natural weighting to 5 km/s channels
Hexagonal Nyquist sampling with 2.0'' apertures (step 1.0''); one-component fit if peak S/N>5, two-component if residual peak S/N>5
key_parameters: Broad component defined as FWHM > 500 km/s

recipe.goal: Derive outflow mass, rate, and age
recipe.method: Mdot = 3 v M tan(alpha)/R for uniformly filled cone; launching points at double nuclei
assumptions: inclination 45 deg, CO(2-1)/CO(1-0) ratio unity, alpha_CO = 0.8 Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1

answer_key.quantity: Total CO(2-1) integrated intensity inside 3 sigma

evidence.quote: the mass loading factor ($\dot{M}_{\rm H_2, out}$ divided by SFR) is $\sim$4
found that it ranges from 5 to 27 Myr

not_stated_but_needed: Multiscale scales, cell size, image size, clean threshold
Fitting code and optimizer used for Gaussian fits
How projected velocities and distances were measured from linewidth peaks
missing_for_reproduction: Multiscale scales, cell/image size, clean threshold
Details of measuring projected velocities and distances for the outflow peaks
score_reason: Public data and a clear recipe, but several imaging and measurement parameters are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public single-dataset ALMA data; numeric results (flux, masses, rates) can be re-derived with the stated recipe.
